title: What we bake
meta_description: The regular bakes, what they cost, and when they are out.
sections: Every day unless it says otherwise. Specials go on the board and on the bake list.

Country sourdoughWhite, 36-hour prove6.50
Seeded ryeDense, keeps a week7.00

Cinnamon bunWeekends only3.80

What time should I come?
Bread is out by seven, pastry by half past six. By two on a Saturday there is usually nothing left but a rye and an apology.
Can I order ahead?
Yes, and for weekends you should. Ring or email by Thursday and it will be put aside with your name on it.
Is anything vegan?
The sourdough, the rye and the baguettes always. The pastry is butter and there is no honest way around that.

1. Monday

    The starter is fed

    Everything that comes out on Wednesday begins here, and nothing about it can be hurried.

  2. Overnight

    The long prove

    Shaped in the evening, proved cold until four in the morning. That is where the flavour is.

  3. 4am

    Ovens on

    Bread first, then pastry, so both hit the counter at the right moment.

  4. By 2pm

    Gone

    We bake what we can sell in a day. Coming late means missing out, and that is the deal.
